facts.fact: Kay 与叙述者打开那栋无窗建筑：双开门宽得能进车，把手孔里只穿着一根绳子，不可能电动开关
facts.anchor: with a little bit of rope threaded through the two holes

facts.fact: 漆黑积灰的棚里塞满健身与户外器材，左边靠墙至少两打细轮赛车，后排是滑雪板与装帐篷的窄长布袋
facts.anchor: at least two dozen of those thin-wheeled racing bikes

facts.fact: 叙述者只草草照了一圈就满足，断定这是 Dan 存 Swole Squad 大件装备的运动棚，事后才承认看漏
facts.anchor: my curiosity was more than sated by this cursory view

facts.fact: 去岗亭的短途换乘 Kay 的 Suburban，车厢里从此没停过话，叙述者发现自己也聊得动
facts.anchor: Kay kept up a steady stream of chatter in her Chevy Suburban

facts.fact: Kay 把「自杀」与「凶杀」并成一句反问自己，眨眼，笑声像小动物
facts.anchor: have I ever had a suicide that might be a homicide case

facts.fact: Uber 司机证实：Deirdre 离开大门约十分钟后被送到 La Dorada Inn and Suites
facts.anchor: dropped her off at the La Dorada Inn and Suites

facts.fact: Alberto 说 Caraway 太太凌晨两点刚过开车出门，近四点才回来
facts.anchor: A little after two in the morning

facts.fact: 电网由岗亭控制、日夜通电，但有一块控制板接触不良会断电，当晚刚用电压表测过
facts.anchor: It goes out sometimes when the circuit is loose

facts.fact: Alberto 没查过 Genevieve 的车：查车只针对客人，拍片的大队人马也不查
facts.anchor: We do that with guests only, miss

facts.fact: 章末两人不约而同做了同一个判断：立刻去找 Genevieve 本人
facts.anchor: We needed to talk to Genevieve Caraway
